scope.mode: read-only primary clean text; no financial calculations, tests, replay or network/exchange API
scope.source_priority: Методичка → SW5 → SW9 → SW11 → SW12 → SW22 → other confirmed ORIGINAL SOURCE materials → SOURCE Rule Registry
scope.priority_warning: This is the lower-priority primary-source contribution; merge with Methodichka review before declaring final source contracts. Code, registry and status documents were context only, never independent SOURCE truth.
scope.visual_scope: No page-image review performed; text-only readings do not resolve missing diagram geometry.

citation_scheme.name: clean-text page-local blank-line block index
citation_scheme.definition:
Split each exact SWx.txt on ^===== SWx PAGE N =====
; within each page use re.split(r"
\s*
", content), discard blocks for which strip() is empty, and number remaining blocks from 1. Headers, footers and headings count, so indexes are mechanically reproducible; they are analyst-generated locators, not printed publisher paragraph numbers. Normalize quote matching with " ".join(block.split()).
citation_scheme.physical_lines: 1-based start/end lines in the immutable checked text file, inclusive; line spans and short verbatim quotes accompany each locator.
citation_scheme.pages: Printed PDF page identity matches the frozen text marker.
citation_scheme.checks: All quote substrings programmatically checked against normalized cited paragraphs; each PDF/text SHA256 checked against frozen manifest.

findings.source_rule: A selected-timeframe swing is a three-consecutive-candle pattern: both adjacent highs are lower than the middle high; both adjacent lows are higher than the middle low. Bull structure has increasing key HH/HL; bear structure has decreasing key LH/LL.
source_defined_geometry: Exactly three consecutive candles.
Strict higher/lower relations, without ATR/tick/percentage tolerance.
qualitative_evidence_required: Identity of the selected timeframe and price dataset.
Identity/provenance of the key swing sequence used for structure; not every peak is a selected-timeframe swing.
unresolved_execution_choices: No unique timeframe or cross-timeframe mapping is selected universally.
Equal-price candles are outside the stated strict swing definition; a plateau/tie variant must not be fabricated.
These paragraphs do not independently define how to choose key structural swings among nested valid swings.
causal_normalization: TECHNICAL_NORMALIZATION: middle-candle formation_at may precede known_at; a three-candle swing cannot be known before the rightmost supporting candle closes.

findings.source_rule: BOS refers to breaking the key low of an ascending trend or key high of a descending trend with body establishment; CONF updates the new structure key low/high. Waiting for CONF is described as conservative.
source_defined_geometry: Relevant break anchor is the cited key structural extremum.
CONF updates the key extremum of the new structure; no ATR buffer or candle-count threshold is supplied.
qualitative_evidence_required: Causally established old trend and key extremum.
Links from the break to new structure and the extremum that CONF updates.
unresolved_execution_choices: Conservative after-CONF timing is source-supported, without making every setup require CONF; preserve setup-specific BOS-or-CONF permission in SW22.

SW5 p4 literally says body establishment "выше" while also describing the ascending-trend low break. Do not derive a universal both-directions close comparator from that single word. Coordinate direction must be read with p5 context and higher-priority source/visual evidence.
Exact entry price and protective-stop distance do not follow from BOS/CONF alone.
causal_normalization: TECHNICAL_NORMALIZATION: record each participating candle and event time; body establishment/CONF cannot be assigned using later unavailable candles.

findings.source_rule: OB text describes liquidity-sweeping candle, aggressive impulsive engulfing candle, imbalance context, BOS, required HTF POI context, whole engulfed candle including wicks, and structural-impulse/trend context. It warns against treating every engulf as OB.
source_defined_geometry: Once the source-valid engulfed candle is identified, OB zone is its full high-low range, including wicks.
qualitative_evidence_required: Swept source-qualified liquidity object and its prior known time.
Identity of engulfed candle and aggressive impulsive engulfing movement.
Imbalance object/link, BOS object/link, source-valid HTF POI containment.
Source-qualified structural impulse, trend direction, and OTE/Premium/Discount context with independent anchor provenance.
unresolved_execution_choices: No numeric definition of aggressive impulse, qualifying sweep context, or structural impulse segmentation is given here.

SW9 p2 says imbalance is the most accurate signal, while p6 warns against ignoring IMB. This review does not resolve their force against higher-priority Methodichka; do not convert to optional or mandatory using code/registry.
No universal HTF/LTF pair or OTE anchor selection is supplied. SW9 does not give the OTE ratios here.
Large-body/small-wick quality is not specified numerically in SW9; the assigned Methodichka analyst must supply the higher-priority wording.
causal_normalization: TECHNICAL_NORMALIZATION: required context objects must be causally known by the annotation decision; record later confirmations as later times rather than backdating OB eligibility.
findings.boundary: Source-specific OB HTF POI provenance must not be confused with the forbidden generic PROJECT HTF admission overlay.

findings.source_rule: Preserve direct boundary/inside-zone entry and direct/LTF-confirmation paths, both stop anchors, and exceptional re-entry conditional on LTF reaction.
source_defined_geometry: Direct bullish boundary is OB upper boundary; direct bearish boundary is OB lower boundary.
Inside-zone entry is a bounded alternative without a unique quote.
Both source stop anchor alternatives are explicit: OB extremum, or engulfing candle wick.
LTF path text gives 15M–1D etc. parent examples and 1–15M child examples; these do not select a universal pair.
qualitative_evidence_required: For LTF path: smooth structural approach, HTF reaction, subsequent LTF BOS and new source-valid POI.
For first-test/re-entry: causal prior-test history and the lower-timeframe reaction; explicit unresolved exceptional-case identity.
unresolved_execution_choices: Exact inside-OB quote.
Exact quote on new POI.
Which qualified timeframe pair to use.
Exact stop quote beyond either anchor, including buffer and LTF refined-stop geometry.
Exceptional cases allowing re-entry, what counts as a first test, attempt identity, cancellation/expiry and repeated touch handling.
The phrase "В 90% случаев" is descriptive practice, not a random admission probability or quota threshold.
causal_normalization: TECHNICAL_NORMALIZATION: LTF-confirmation path known_at must follow the reaction/BOS/new-POI evidence actually required; preserve the direct path separately without precedence.

findings.source_rule: A specific illustrated nested-OB/IMB situation distinguishes the confirmation path from the lower-OB direct path after IMB coverage.
qualitative_evidence_required: If using this example, preserve identities of both OBs and their IMB/coverage relation and cite the actual source illustration.
unresolved_execution_choices: A text-only example does not provide a general scoring, profitability-based selection, or global precedence rule.
No generalized multiple-POI selection algorithm is inferred here.

findings.source_rule: Breaker is a source-valid OB pierced by a quick, whole impulsive movement without trading/consolidation in the OB area; SW9 relates it to BOS and a new HH/LL and allows continuation as well as reversal context.
source_defined_geometry: Breaker inherits the cited OB identity rather than any arbitrary pierced candle.
qualitative_evidence_required: Underlying source-valid OB and its lifecycle.
Causal impulse segmentation, intact/whole impulse and absence of trading/consolidation in OB area.
New HH/LL, BOS and trend linkage.
Imbalance-pierce/CHOCH requirements, if supplied by higher-priority Methodichka, must be supplied by that analyst; they were not silently inferred from SW9.
unresolved_execution_choices: No numeric definition for quick, impulsive, whole or without trading/consolidation.
Exact Breaker entry quote, order type, timing/expiry, retest identity and protective-stop buffer remain unspecified by these text passages.

findings.source_rule: Aggressive and conservative stops are both explicitly permitted.
source_defined_geometry: Aggressive: immediately under Breaker in the textual example.
Conservative: beyond liquidity-sweeping impulse-candle extreme.
qualitative_evidence_required: Identity of Breaker zone and source-valid liquidity-sweeping impulse candle.
unresolved_execution_choices: Exact "immediately under"/"beyond" offset.
Directional mirroring of the aggressive example requires source context; do not invent a buffer.
Source descriptive claims about RR/stop frequency do not authorize choosing a winning branch.

findings.source_rule: POI is a family of reaction zones; FTA is the first trouble zone opposing the entry. Both trend and countertrend work are described, and both full and partial fixation are permitted.
source_defined_geometry: Full fixation denotes the full position (allocation 1.0); this is a semantic normalization of "полную", not a preferred branch.
FTA is anchored to a source-qualified opposing POI, not a fixed RR or arbitrary price fraction.
qualitative_evidence_required: Selected causal FTA POI identity, higher-timeframe context, relationship to entry direction, and why it is the first trouble area.
For trend/countertrend context: linked HTF/LTF structures and transition from correction to impulse or impulse to correction.
unresolved_execution_choices: Exact exit quote within/at the FTA zone.
Partial fraction and all remainder destinations, stop lifecycle and termination.
Which qualifying opposing POI is selected where several exist; no profitability/scoring solution.
Source permits countertrend FTA logic without overriding OB-specific trend restrictions.

findings.source_rule: Entry, exit and TP must be determined before entry; use only facts present on the chart; do not enter without knowing stop location; do not move the stop or place it at liquidity accumulation.
source_defined_geometry: Technical stop is behind a relevant level/obstacle; this gives an anchor relation without a universal numeric buffer.
qualitative_evidence_required: Pre-entry stop anchor and causal chart evidence.
Known opposing/adverse liquidity pool(s) at the proposed stop, with provenance; absence cannot be assumed from missing annotations.
unresolved_execution_choices: Exact beyond-level buffer and how source-qualified liquidity accumulation is identified.
A monetary risk bound cannot manufacture missing structural stop geometry.
findings.boundary: Account, portfolio, leverage, daily-loss and other PROJECT policies are not added to PURE SOURCE by this review.

findings.source_rule: SW11 gives source risk guidance and arithmetic; none supplies a universal missing price coordinate or fixed SOURCE FTA target.
source_defined_geometry: Per-trade account-risk guidance explicitly mentions no more than 2%, dependent on system settings, and a recommended 0.25–2% range.
Position-size relation is quoted verbatim; dimensional conventions are not silently repaired.
Last-price stop trigger is recommended in source.
qualitative_evidence_required: Provenance/classification of any later source-risk parameter choice; keep it distinct from structural object validity.
unresolved_execution_choices: A unique risk percentage is not selected by the range.
The quoted sizing formula requires units/amount-vs-percent normalization before any execution use; no calculation is authorized here.
SW11 3R/5R and monthly arithmetic are explanatory examples; no general FTA replacement, minimum RR, portfolio selection, leverage limit or fixed 5R target is inferred.
findings.boundary: Source account-risk guidance is recorded as source context only; this task excludes applying project portfolio/leverage policy or running financial outcomes.

findings.source_rule: Read ATR on the SFP candle; source gives an ATR-distance example from the lower point, keeps protective order fixed, and invalidates SFP when a candle closes beyond the pattern extreme.
source_defined_geometry: Worked example: BTC H3 ATR volatility is 403 points counted from the lower point. 403 is example data, never a universal stop distance.
Invalidation is a candle close below SFP minimum for buys, or beyond SFP maximum for sells as text states in the parenthetical.
qualitative_evidence_required: Source-valid SFP pattern identity from higher-priority analyst, exact SFP candle and extreme, selected ATR settings/timeframe, and quote unit.
Protective-order identity plus the actual closed candle causing invalidation.
unresolved_execution_choices: Selected ATR period variant and ATR calculation details (true-range smoothing/seed) are not specified by the selected text.
Generic universal ATR-multiple formula should not be claimed solely from a worked 403-point example; source scope/visual or higher-priority evidence must support generalization.
The source manual-close instruction does not define machine execution latency, fill price or an exchange-order implementation.
causal_normalization: TECHNICAL_NORMALIZATION: pattern invalidated_at cannot precede the invalidating close; distinguish invalidation event from unspecified execution fill. No future ATR values may be used.

findings.source_rule: Standard ATR period is 14; source permits strategy-dependent adjusted settings. Indicators remain auxiliary and must be checked.
source_defined_geometry: ATR standard period 14 is exact once timeframe/data/calculation contract is selected.
7 and 28 are explicit illustrative settings, not a complete enumeration of the allowed adjusted-period family.
PDH/PDL are previous-day high/low liquidity-pool identities; no meaning/selection tolerance is added.
qualitative_evidence_required: ATR branch/settings provenance, timeframe and SFP candle linkage.
If using prior-day liquidity, causal day boundary and level identity.
unresolved_execution_choices: No unique adjusted period or universal precedence over 14.
Source ATR text recommends comparing strategy results, but this project forbids profitability-based branch selection; preserve alternatives without implementing that comparison.
No chosen smoothing/initialization/day-session standard is supplied by these passages.
Indicator output alone cannot replace source-qualified structure/liquidity annotations.

findings.source_rule: STB/BTS entries require main-trend agreement, a liquidity-pool sweep, complete engulf of the manipulation on reversal, and BOS or CONF. Preserve directional-zone-part and exact 0.5 entry alternatives.
source_defined_geometry: Exact 0.5 of the full STB/BTS zone is a source-defined midpoint once source-valid zone endpoints are known.
Upper zone part for LONG / lower zone part for SHORT is a source-permitted bounded alternative; text does not define one exact quote or precise subzone boundary.
BOS OR CONF is explicitly allowed; do not universally require both.
qualitative_evidence_required: Causally selected main-trend structure with timeframe provenance.
Identity and prior known time of the swept liquidity pool.
Manipulation start/end and full-zone anchor identities.
Engulfing reversal segment with evidence that the entire selected manipulation was engulfed.
Actual causal BOS/CONF event(s), and later mitigation/test evidence if used.
unresolved_execution_choices: No numeric manipulation segmentation, sweep meaningfulness, engulf body/wick convention or main-trend timeframe selector is supplied in these paragraphs.
Exact directional-part quote and precise directional subzone boundary.
Protective stop anchor/buffer, exit allocation/targets, expiry/re-entry and fills are not supplied for STB/BTS here.
The marketmaker-position narrative does not establish observable latent positions; annotate the chart evidence rather than asserting hidden positions.
causal_normalization: TECHNICAL_NORMALIZATION: formation may span the manipulation; confirmation/known_at follows complete engulf and the chosen BOS-or-CONF evidence. Do not label the future-completed manipulation valid at its start.

findings.source_rule: Order Flow text requires liquidity interaction in addition to classical trend and links its lifecycle to a global POI test.
qualitative_evidence_required: Source-qualified global POI, causal trend/extrema and actual liquidity operations.
unresolved_execution_choices: No quantitative rule for selecting the marketmaker/global POI or when a test counts as complete.
No new price/ATR/score threshold or hidden-position assertion is authorized by this explanation.

annotation_contract_handoff.classification: TECHNICAL_NORMALIZATION proposal grounded in source evidence; not a new SOURCE geometry rule
minimum_provenance: annotation_id and parent-object ids; source identity + checksum + page/paragraph + short quote
dataset identity, timeframe, candle ids and causal cutoff
assertion status SUPPORTED / CONTRADICTED / UNKNOWN; missing evidence remains UNKNOWN
formation_at, known_at, confirmed_at, invalidated_at with supporting causal candles/events and explanation of any null
qualitative decision rationale linked to the actual source phrase and observed chart segment
all explicit finite variants as stable alternatives; no preferred/default/outcome-based choice
unresolved execution coordinates and geometry tracked separately from object validity
causal_boundary: Evidence dependencies must already be known at the decision cutoff. A later annotation/review time is separate from the time the underlying evidence first became available.
Human hindsight cannot backdate known_at or PASS. Final-segment selection must be explainable from the prefix evidence.
Do not infer object eligibility, trade entry or executable orders from a source-valid zone or an exact branch coordinate.
No arbitrary ATR/OHLC/tick/percentage/fraction/ML/score thresholds may replace qualitative impulse, liquidity, body/wick, reaction or manipulation provenance.
safe_unknowns: No market-data annotation corpus was reviewed; every proposed qualitative field remains a contract requirement, not an asserted PASS for an actual market object.
No source conclusion here changes trade_entry_allowed=false or baseline_identifiability=NOT_IDENTIFIABLE.

methodichka_handoff: Provide higher-priority OB large-body/small-wick wording and whether IMB and structural update are mandatory; SW9 must not silently relax it.
Provide higher-priority Breaker sweep/imbalance-pierce/CHOCH requirements and combine with SW9 whole-impulse/no-trading context.
Provide original SFP formation/candle-count/context/entry definitions; SW12 supplies the ATR protection and invalidation contribution only.
Provide Range, OTE anchor, EQH/EQL reasonable-tilt, Demand/Supply last-movement and other higher-priority qualitative provenance; these primary modules do not close those gaps.
Resolve source precedence conflicts explicitly; do not prefer Stage17 registry/code over either primary text or Methodichka.
